candidates.summary: Render's only call-to-action link hardcodes /r/example/hello, which is the wrong realm after the README's documented module re-point
candidates.failure_scenario: README.md:61 now tells the newcomer to point `module` in gnomod.toml at `gno.land/r/<your-address>/hello` and deploy. Render's body still emits `[And click here](/r/example/hello$help&func=Set&newMsg=Hello%20from%20Gnokey!)`, so on their deployed page the single clickable action goes to a realm they do not own: a dead link where r/example/hello does not exist on that network, and a call against someone else's realm where it does, which leaves their own page unchanged. Pre-existing in hello.gno; in scope because this PR writes the re-point instruction and adds the first test that asserts Render's output.
